# BookImmo

> Find the perfect property. Viewings booked automatically, before the crowd.

BookImmo is a property discovery and booking platform that automatically schedules viewings for buyers and renters. The most sought-after properties disappear within hours — BookImmo gets users in first.

## Core offering

- Automatic viewing requests submitted the moment a matching listing appears
- Real-time alerts for new properties matching saved search criteria
- Connects buyers and renters with local real estate agents
- Available in English, French, German, Dutch, and Italian markets

## Pages

- [Home](https://book.immo/): Main landing page — waitlist sign-up, product overview, agent directory
- [Search](https://book.immo/search): Property search with filters (price, size, location, type)
- [Agents](https://book.immo/agent): Directory of partner real estate agents
